vkzemkzy.sourceDescription: One of our most realistic Christmas trees, the Woodland Pine has a "freshly cut" look. A bushy Christmas tree boasting dark green foliage and a mix of PE & PVC branch tips, the Woodland Pine has a charming realism to it that few artificial Christmas trees achieve. What's more, this 8ft pre-lit Christmas tree comes with LEDs already attached to the branches that's right, no more untangling Christmas lights! The tips are expertly moulded from real tree needles to create a greater degree of realism. You'll also find strong hinged branches on the Woodland Pine, making the tree easy to put up and bring down. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. 7a7sgfmv.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
7a7sgfmv.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
7a7sgfmv.sourceDescription: This contemporary artificial Christmas tree offers an elegant festive touch to any space. Blending modern design with holiday tradition, it serves as an ideal centerpiece for both indoor and outdoor festivities, emanating a welcoming glow. Sleek Modern Design Highlighting clean lines and minimal ornamentation, this tree resonates with modern aesthetics. Its streamlined silhouette complements contemporary home decor beautifully, creating a stylish yet timeless festive atmosphere. Convenient USB Connectivity: Equipped with a USB connector, this tree allows for versatile power options, ensuring effortless setup without the need for traditional outlets. This ensures flexibility for positioning anywhere at home or outside. Warm White LED Lights: This tree illuminates your space with charming, energy-efficient LED lighting. The soft, warm white glow creates an inviting ambiance, enhancing holiday gatherings whether tucked in a cozy living room or gracing a scenic terrace. Durable PVC &Steel Build: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree showcases lasting resilience while remaining light enough for easy portability. Supporting the tree, a steel frame provides stability, ensuring it withstands seasonal celebrations year after year. Simple Assembly and Maintenance: This product features a streamlined setup requiring just a screwdriver, making quick work of assembly. To maintain its appearance, cover the tree when not in use, protecting it during inclement weather or off-seasons. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and plastic and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 66 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Decorated with pine corns Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PVC tips: 440 Number of pine cones: 23 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 150 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hvqs9jvd.baseName: Charles Bentley Large Rattan Light Up Reindeer
hvqs9jvd.variantName: Charles Bentley Large Rattan Light Up Reindeer
hvqs9jvd.sourceDescription: Add a festive sparkle to your home or garden with our large light up Reindeer – a charming addition to your Christmas display that brings warmth and magic to any setting. Crafted from natural-look rattan woven around a brown metal frame, this elegant deer is wrapped in glowing white Micro LED lights, creating a beautifully soft, seasonal glow. Designed for ease and practicality, the reindeer features a built-in timer (8 hours on, 16 hours off), so you can enjoy coming home to a beautifully lit entrance way with no need to switch on or off all season long. It's suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, and comes supplied with miniature cable ties and ground pegs for added stability in your garden. The reindeer can be disassembled if required for stress-free storage. Whether standing proudly on your lawn or adding a whimsical touch indoors, this elegant deer is the perfect way to light up the season. Features: • Micro LED Lights • Timer Function • Indoor and Outdoor Use • Plug In Includes: • 1x Large Light Up Reindeer • 4x Ground Pegs • 2x Leg Struts • 10x Zip Ties Materials: • Metal • Rattan Dimensions: H120, W65, D23cm Cable length: 5m Not for children under 3 years Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

xyacksy4.baseName: Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand 50cm Base Integrated Power Outlet
xyacksy4.variantName: Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand 50cm Base Integrated Power Outlet
xyacksy4.sourceDescription: Showcase your festive decorations from every angle with the Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand, suitable for trees up to 2.1m tall. Featuring a 50cm diameter star-shaped base, this electric Christmas tree stand offers a choice of lighting only or lighting with rotation, controlled by a simple three-position switch. Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm sizes to accommodate different tree poles, while the integrated power outlet lets you connect your Christmas tree lights for an eye-catching festive display. SUITABLE FOR TREES UP TO 2.1M: Display your Christmas tree on a 50cm diameter, five-point star-shaped base. ROTATING CHRISTMAS TREE STAND: Show off your baubles, lights and decorations from every angle with powered rotation. THREE-POSITION SWITCH: Switch up for lights on with rotation off, select the middle position to turn both off, or switch down for lights and rotation on. CHOICE OF POLE HOLDERS: Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm diameters. Select the correct size for your tree. INTEGRATED LIGHTING OUTLET: Connect your Christmas tree lights using the built-in outlet. Supplied with a black power cable and UK three-pin plug. For indoor domestic use only. This product is not a toy. Keep children and pets away from the rotating mechanism, electrical connections and power cable. Suitable for artificial christmas trees up to 2.1m tall, provided the tree is compatible with the stand. Ensure the stand is positioned on a flat, stable and level surface before use. Select the correct pole holder size (19mm, 22mm or 32mm) and ensure the tree is securely fitted before switching on. Do not exceed the manufacturer's specified weight or electrical load limits. Keep hands, clothing, decorations and other objects clear of moving parts during rotation. Only connect compatible christmas tree lights to the integrated power outlet. Do not overload the socket or use damaged electrical cables. Keep away from water, moisture and heat sources. Do not operate if the stand, plug, cable or rotating mechanism is damaged. Always switch off and unplug before assembling, adjusting, cleaning or moving the tree. Do not leave the product operating unattended. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Retain all instructions for future reference. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
